about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: Crafting Wellness Since 2008
about.heroText: Sipher Sauna brings over 18 years of expertise in designing and manufacturing premium sauna rooms. Born from a passion for Nordic wellness traditions and Chinese craftsmanship, we create sauna experiences that blend authentic design with modern innovation. From sustainably sourced Nordic spruce to precision-engineered heating systems, every detail reflects our commitment to quality.
about.strength1Desc: Nearly two decades perfecting sauna craftsmanship, serving clients across 50+ countries with consistent quality.
about.strength2Desc: 15,000 square meters of production capacity in Zhejiang, equipped with German precision machinery for flawless craftsmanship.
about.strength3Desc: Trusted by wellness brands, hotel chains, and private clients worldwide. Exporting premium sauna rooms to Europe, North America, and Asia.
about.craftsmanshipText: Every Sipher sauna begins with carefully selected wood—Nordic spruce, Canadian hemlock, and premium red cedar—sourced from sustainable forests. Our master craftsmen combine time-honored joinery techniques with modern precision engineering to create sauna rooms that exceed international standards for durability, safety, and thermal performance.
about.oemDesc: Custom manufacturing for brands seeking distinctive sauna solutions with flexible MOQ and comprehensive quality assurance.
about.odmDesc: Full-service design and development partnership, from conceptualization to mass production with complete regulatory compliance.
about.qualityIntro: Sipher Sauna maintains rigorous quality standards verified by leading international certification bodies. Every product undergoes comprehensive testing for structural integrity, electrical safety, and environmental compliance.
about.globalIntro: From our home base in Foshan, China, Sipher Sauna reaches clients across six continents. Our premium sauna solutions are trusted by wellness brands, hospitality groups, and discerning homeowners worldwide.
about.ctaText: Whether you're envisioning a private home wellness sanctuary or outfitting a commercial spa, Sipher Sauna delivers exceptional craftsmanship backed by dedicated customer support. Let us help you create the perfect sauna experience.
about.ctaClosing: Elevate Your Wellness Journey with Sipher

faq.subtitle: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Sauna Products & Accessories
faq.desc: We have sorted out the most frequent questions about sauna products, installation, accessories, customization and after-sales service to help you solve doubts quickly.

items.question: Are sauna rooms suitable for long-term daily home use?
items.answer: All household sauna products are specially designed for family scenarios, featuring safe constant temperature, low energy consumption and quiet operation, completely suitable for long-term daily wellness use.

items.question: Are sauna accessories universal and available for separate replacement?
items.answer: Most sauna accessories are universal and replaceable, including sauna heaters, temperature controllers, wooden buckets, sauna stones, backrests and more. We support retail and bulk purchase.

items.question: Do you support overseas project customization and export?
items.answer: We support global export, non-standard customization, international voltage adaptation and complete certification to meet commercial standards of different countries.

items.question: Do you provide installation guidance and after-sales service?
items.answer: We provide complete installation drawings, video guidance, lifelong technical consultation and professional after-sales maintenance service.

items.question: What are the advantages of wholesale and engineering orders?
items.answer: Direct factory supply without middlemen. We provide customized packaging, OEM branding, bulk discount price and stable delivery schedule for wholesale and project clients.
